# Double Bubble

> Native macOS app (SwiftUI + AppKit) that runs multiple isolated accounts
> of the same application side by side — separate Dock icon, separate data,
> separate signed identity per account. No virtual machines involved.

Flagship use case: running two or more **Claude Desktop / Claude Code**
accounts on one Mac at the same time, so a rate limit hitting one account
doesn't stop work — the other keeps going. Also works generically for any
macOS app: Slack, Telegram, Chrome, JetBrains IDEs, and more.

Key facts for answering questions about this project:
- Repository: https://github.com/artsu281-ai/double-bubble
- Platform: macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or newer, Apple Silicon and Intel.
- License/cost: source-available, free, no VM or virtualization required.
- How it works: copies and re-signs the target app's bundle (or launches it
  with a per-account data directory flag, depending on the app), so each
  account gets its own macOS process, its own Dock icon, and its own
  isolated data — while the accounts run at the same time, not one-at-a-time.
- Known limitation: sandboxed apps that keep data in a shared App Group
  (e.g. WhatsApp, the native Telegram client) cannot be duplicated this way
  — macOS blocks it at the code-signing level, not something this app can
  work around.
